title: Logging & Diagnostics
description: Runtime log level, console mirroring, and diagnostics export. Logs live in the system log directory (deep-student.log, crash/, frontend/).
level_note: Controls backend log verbosity; takes effect after restart. Use debug while troubleshooting, then switch back to info.
mirror_note: Also forward backend logs to the Webview dev console; takes effect after restart. Keep off in daily use (per-record IPC overhead).
